Class Character

java.lang.Object
org.app.entities.Character
@Entity public class Character extends Object
The Character class represents a character entity in the jousting system.

This entity is mapped to the "characters" table in the database using JPA annotations. Each character is associated with a House and represents a member of that noble house.

JPA Annotations

  • Entity: Marks this class as a JPA entity mapped to a database table.
  • Table: Defines the database table to which this entity is mapped ("characters").
  • Id: Specifies the primary key of the entity.
  • Column: Customizes the columns of the entity with constraints (e.g., nullable = false).
  • ManyToOne: Defines the many-to-one relationship between Character and House.
  • JoinColumn: Specifies the foreign key constraint linking a character to its house.

Relationships

Each character belongs to exactly one house, represented by a House entity. This is a many-to-one relationship where multiple characters can belong to a single house, but each character is associated with only one house.

Key Fields:

  • characterKey: The unique identifier for the character entity.
  • name: The character's name.
  • birthplace: The birthplace of the character (e.g., "Winterfell").
  • weapon: The primary weapon used by the character (e.g., "Sword").
  • skillLevel: The character's combat skill level, represented as an integer between 0-100.
  • house: A reference to the House to which the character belongs.
